#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

namespace GeometryUtils {
    const double epsilon = 1e-8;

    double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
        return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
    }
}

class Point {
public:
    double x, y;

    Point(double x_, double y_) : x(x_), y(y_) {}

    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return (fabs(x - other.x) <= GeometryUtils::epsilon + 1e-12) &&
               (fabs(y - other.y) <= GeometryUtils::epsilon + 1e-12);
    }

    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        return GeometryUtils::fastHypot(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
};

class Line {
public:
    double a, b, c;

    Line(const Point& p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }
    Line(double a_, double b_, double c_) {
        double h = GeometryUtils::fastHypot(a_, b_);
        a = a_ / h;
        b = b_ / h;
        c = c_ / h;
    }
    bool parallel(const Line& other) const {
        return fabs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < GeometryUtils::epsilon + 1e-12;
    }
    Point intersect(const Line& other) const {
        if (parallel(other)) {
            return Point(0, 0); // Should not be used if they are parallel
        }
        double determinant = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        double x_ = (c * other.b - b * other.c) / determinant;
        double y_ = (a * other.c - c * other.a) / determinant;
        return Point(x_, y_);
    }
    Line perpendicular(const Point& p) const {
        return Line(-b, a, b * p.x - a * p.y);
    }
    double value(const Point& p) const {
        return a * p.x + b * p.y + c;
    }

    vector<Point> intersect(const class Circle& circle) const;
    bool operator==(const Line& other) const {
        if (!parallel(other)) return false;
        if (fabs(a * other.c - c * other.a) > GeometryUtils::epsilon + 1e-12) return false;
        if (fabs(b * other.c - c * other.b) > GeometryUtils::epsilon + 1e-12) return false;
        return true;
    }
};

class Circle {
public:
    Point center;
    double radius;

    Circle(const Point& c_, double r_) : center(c_), radius(r_) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double dist = center.distance(other.center);
        if (dist < GeometryUtils::epsilon) return vector<Point>();
        // Line equation
        double A = 2 * (other.center.x - center.x);
        double B = 2 * (other.center.y - center.y);
        double C = other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                   center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y;
        Line line(Point(0,0),0); // dummy initialization
        line = Line(A, B, C);
        vector<Point> res = line.intersect(*this);
        return res;
    }
};

vector<Point> Line::intersect(const Circle& circle) const {
    double dist = fabs(value(circle.center));
    if (dist > circle.radius + GeometryUtils::epsilon) {
        return vector<Point>();
    }
    Point inter = intersect(Line(perpendicular(circle.center)));
    if (fabs(dist - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils::epsilon + 1e-12) {
        return vector<Point>{inter};
    }
    double shift = sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);

    ans.push_back(Point(inter.x + shift * b, inter.y - shift * a));
    ans.push_back(Point(inter.x - shift * b, inter.y + shift * a));
